name: UTM Tracker for Contact Form 7
author: Adnan Buksh

sections.description:
UTM Tracker for Contact Form 7 is a lightweight plugin that automatically captures UTM parameters from the URL and appends them to Contact Form 7 email notifications.

Perfect for marketers, freelancers, and businesses who want to track marketing campaigns, ad performance, and lead sources—all without writing any code.

This plugin works out of the box, supports all standard UTM parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content), and is compatible with cached pages via cookie storage.

✅ Features

  • Automatically injects UTM parameters into selected CF7 forms
  • Stores UTM values in cookies (persist for up to 30 days)
  • Works perfectly with cached pages and most caching plugins
  • Appends UTM data to the CF7 email body
  • Skips empty UTM fields (no clutter)
  • Fully plug-and-play — no configuration needed
  • Clean and minimal codebase
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins directory.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → UTM Tracker for Contact Form 7 and select which forms should track UTM data.
sections.faq:
Does it work with cached pages?

Yes! UTM values are stored in cookies on the first visit and injected into the form later. This makes it compatible with most caching setups.

Does it track all UTM parameters?

Yes. It supports utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, and utm_content by default.

Will this slow down my site?

Not at all. It’s optimized for performance and uses native WordPress & JavaScript APIs only when needed.

Can I use this with multiple forms?

Yes. You can choose which Contact Form 7 forms should track UTM data from the plugin settings.
